external_deps: AI provider API key or Claude Code/Codex CLI

review.tagline: Task manager that turns a PRD into tasks for AI coding agents
review.summary: Task Master runs as an MCP server or CLI (task-master) and parses a PRD into structured tasks with dependencies, subtasks, tags and a research command. Editors such as Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code and Q CLI, plus Claude Code, call it to plan and pick the next task. It needs a provider API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Perplexity, xAI, OpenRouter and others) or the Claude Code or Codex CLI.
review.audience: Developers using Cursor, Claude Code or similar agents on multi-step projects
strengths: Works as an MCP server or CLI, installed with npx or npm
Separate main, research and fallback models across many providers
Claude Code and Codex CLI usable without an API key
TASK_MASTER_TOOLS limits loaded tools to 7, 15 or all 36
weaknesses: MIT with Commons Clause: no selling it or offering it as a hosted service
Default loads all 36 tools, about 21,000 tokens of context
Task quality depends on writing a detailed PRD first
AI commands need a provider API key or a Claude Code/Codex CLI login
needs: Needs Node.js, npm, AI provider API key or Claude Code/Codex CLI
Models: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Perplexity, xAI
